features.name: v1_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized recency of last donation (V1) using training mean and std
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes V1 to unit scale for fair distance computation in KNN

features.name: v2_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized frequency of donations (V2) using training mean and std
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes V2 to unit scale for fair distance computation in KNN

features.name: v3_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized total blood donated in cc (V3) using training mean and std
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes V3 to unit scale for fair distance computation in KNN

features.name: v4_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized time since first donation in months (V4) using training mean and std
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes V4 to unit scale for fair distance computation in KNN

features.name: donation_frequency_rate
features.description: Ratio of donation frequency to time span (V2/V4), measuring donation intensity over career
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures donation behavior intensity as a single normalized ratio useful for neighborhood geometry

features.name: recency_to_frequency_ratio
features.description: Ratio of recency (V1) to frequency (V2), indicating how recently relative to how often they donate
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures recency-frequency interaction pattern useful for distinguishing donor classes

features.name: blood_volume_per_donation
features.description: Average blood volume per donation (V3/V2), should be near 250cc per donation
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies anomalous donation records and consistency of donation volume

features.name: euclidean_dist_to_class1_prototype
features.description: Euclidean distance in z-score space to the approximate class 1 prototype (frequent recent donors)
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct distance to dominant class prototype improves KNN boundary estimation

features.name: euclidean_dist_to_class2_prototype
features.description: Euclidean distance in z-score space to the approximate class 2 prototype (infrequent donors)
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct distance to minority class prototype improves KNN boundary estimation

features.name: prototype_distance_ratio
features.description: Ratio of distance to class1 prototype vs class2 prototype, indicating relative proximity
features.expected_model_benefit: Single feature capturing relative class membership likelihood based on prototype distances

features.name: log_total_blood_donated
features.description: Log-transformed total blood donated (V3) to compress heavy right tail
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skewness in V3 for more uniform distance contributions in KNN

features.name: donor_engagement_score
features.description: Semantic score from 0 to 1 assessing overall donor engagement based on recency, frequency, and career length patterns. High scores indicate active, frequent, long-term donors likely in class 1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic engagement signal that captures non-linear interactions between features for better neighborhood clustering
